answer: Home pickup isn't available in Texas, so you'd need to book an appraisal appointment at a store instead. For that appointment, bring a physical photo ID for every owner on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer disclosure statement (form NW-ODO-2). Because the car is leased, also bring your dealer payoff quote. Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
